what-the-model-is-and-what-it-abstracts.text: The trie answers two questions and nothing else: is this key known, and where in its life is it. The abstractions are named alongside what they therefore cannot show — tagged commitments stand for collision-free commitments but say nothing about a real digest, and supplied contract evidence stands for a ledger that ran the application validators but says nothing about what those validators do.

the-retirement-map.text: The previous model had forty-four generic declarations, and registry mode replaced the alphabet, so most no longer have a subject. Every one is accounted for — one carried, three renamed, forty retired, each with its reason — because without this an auditor cannot tell a dropped guarantee from a rename, and a manifest that quietly lost rows would still satisfy every count.

what-is-covered-and-what-is-not.text: Covered: the seven edges and their deltas, refusal as the complement of the edge table, admission scoped to the request tuple, the leaf codec both ways, the fold and its mint check, the custody census and the deposit destination, and the eleven promises over reachable states.

Not covered, and named rather than left to be discovered: on-chain conformance; plurality constructed from genesis; and any quantitative mutation coverage. The simulator replays thirty-eight registry rows, twenty-four naming rows and twenty-one lifecycle rows and reproduces each verdict, with a mirror check binding the Lean it ships to the Lean it was built from — but that is agreement on the exported inputs, not equivalence, and the transcriber is the model's author, so it is not an independent measurement either.
